content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Gorakhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Gorakhpur Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at AIIMS Gorakhpur is scheduled for 04 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident posts at AIIMS Gorakhpur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Gorakhpur has announced a total of 50 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts across various disciplines. This presents a significant opportunity for eligible medical professionals.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is a Post Graduate Medical Degree in the respective discipline from a NMC recognized University/Institute. This ensures that candidates have the necessary specialized knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years. However, age relaxation is provided for candidates belonging to reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 67700 Per Month, which is at Level-11, Cell No. 01 as per the 7th CPC, along with usual allowances including NPA if applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the Senior Resident posts at AIIMS Gorakhpur?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview on the specified date with all required documents. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q7. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable). Recent passport-size photographs are also required.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 500/-, while SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 250/-. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Interview. However, a Written Screening Test may be conducted if there is a large number of applications.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, Gorakhpur - 273008. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the exact reporting time and specific venue details.
